messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Smart-routing errors spike in us-west-2. Canary variant returning 5xxs; fallback routing engaged repeatedly. Metrics: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/route-alerts

alex_oncall: saw this, I'm on it. severity? impact to customers?

jordan_sre: early look: canary variant `rw/gpt-slim-v2-canary` is throwing tokenization OOMs on longer prompts -> 502s. Traffic falls back to stable variant in other regions but sticky-affinity is reattaching requests back to canary which triggers a routing oscillation.

maya_runtime: confirming logs from inference nodes: 
```
2026-03-15T09:02:11Z ERROR request_id=abc123 model=rw/gpt-slim-v2-canary oom while allocating 1.2GiB
2026-03-15T09:02:12Z WARN router sticky-affinity hit for user=acct-42 policy=canary-affinity
2026-03-15T09:02:12Z INFO fallback->region=us-east-1 variant=stable
2026-03-15T09:02:13Z INFO sticky-affinity reattach -> routed back to us-west-2
```

jordan_sre: TL;DR: fallback works but sticky affinity TTL too aggressive, causes clients to bounce back and forth. error %, p50 latency up.

alex_oncall: ok plan: 1) pause the canary rollout 2) evict sticky affinity for affected buckets 3) rollback canary if errors persist. Who can run the pause?

maya_runtime: I can pause the rollout. Running: `redwoodctl rollout pause --id=rollout-20260315-7f3a`

ops-bot: rollout rollou t-20260315-7f3a paused by maya_runtime at 2026-03-15T09:05:02Z :white_check_mark:

maya_runtime: pausing reduced direct traffic to canary but affinity still reattaching for some sessions. Need to evict sticky entries for impacted selector. Suggest evict command: 
```
redwoodctl routing evict --policy=canary-affinity --selector="variant=rw/gpt-slim-v2-canary" --region=us-west-2 --dry-run
redwoodctl routing evict --policy=canary-affinity --selector="variant=rw/gpt-slim-v2-canary" --region=us-west-2
```

jordan_sre: +1 run evict. add `--confirm` in prod script (we ran dry-run, looks safe).

maya_runtime: running evict now...

ops-bot: evict job started (job-id: evict-2159876543-1) by maya_runtime

maya_runtime: evict completed. early metric delta: errors from 5.1% -> 1.2% in 60s. latency p95 improved.

alex_oncall: customer impact? Lucy, can you patch CS message for customers on affected accounts?

lucy_cs: drafting now. Affected customers: acct-42, acct-77, and subset of free-tier trials in us-west-2. Writing message: "We're seeing intermittent errors in us-west-2 for some API requests. We've paused a rollout and applied a routing fix. No data loss; some requests may have errored. We're monitoring and will follow up with timeline." Will post once approved.

sam_prod: quick note - we should also check rollout config TTL and affinity policy defaults in console. If TTL is too low, clients reselect and that can churn nodes.

jordan_sre: confirmed: policy `canary-affinity` had TTL=30s and sticky window=60s with immediate reattach allowed. That's the misconfiguration here: sticky allowed reattach across region fallback. We'll make a short-term change to disable cross-region reattach for canary policies.

patrick_eng: assigning follow-up: postmortem + config fix. I'll own the postmortem and get a PR for a default safe config.

ops-bot: paging next oncall: @alex_oncall -> @jordan_sre for 1hr handoff (reason: follow-up checks + rollout config)

alex_oncall: handing off to jordan_sre for next 60m. notes: canary paused, sticky evicted, customer comm draft pending. monitor for recurrence and schedule rollback if errors >2% for 10m.

jordan_sre: acked. will monitor graphs and confirm sticky cache drain across nodes. Will also add temporary alert for cross-region reattach > 1/min.

maya_runtime: additional mitigation pushed: router change to prevent reattach if fallback was triggered within last 2m. Quick patch applied to staging then to prod router fleet. Patch id: router-patch-2137.

ops-bot: router-patch-2137 deployed to prod by maya_runtime at 2026-03-15T09:18:40Z

jordan_sre: golden signals look stable now. I've added a follow-up ticket: INC-2026-3298 (root cause: permissive sticky-affinity + canary resource underprovision). Remediation: tighten default affinity TTL, enforce cross-region no-reattach for canaries, enhance rollout preflight to detect long-tail memory usage.

lucy_cs: posted customer note to status page and queued targeted emails to the three impacted accounts.

sam_prod: we'll also block auto-rollout resumes until validation job runs. `redwoodctl rollout set-guard --id=rollout-20260315-7f3a --validation=memory-usage,smoke-tests`

maya_runtime: added validation guards, rollback is set as a safety if memory-usage > 1.5GiB median across nodes.

patrick_eng: planning: triage meeting 11:00 PT to draft postmortem. Owners: patrick_eng (postmortem), maya_runtime (runtime fix), jordan_sre (routing policy), sam_prod (rollout guard).

alex_oncall: closing the active pager. If metrics regress, we re-open. Thanks team. :heart:
